detail: Full summary: Agent-resume quirk: archive-35, resumed after an API disconnect, did its work inside weights-34's worktree instead of its own — the two diffs were co-located. Harmless here (combined suite was green) but worth knowing: a resumed background agent may not reattach to its original worktree.
